ad: Siddulaiah Kona forest, near Varadaiahpalem, Tirupati district, Andhra Pradesh
d: Waterfall about 80 km north of Chennai. The trek is up to about 10 km over rocky ground; beginners can walk a 3 km trail along the stream, while fitter hikers boulder up to the base of the falls.
